description:
About the Scholarship

Huddersfield's human and health sciences research scholarships support doctoral work within the School's advertised research areas. The January 2027 route is a project and academic selection process, so applicants should use the School's call to identify the work they want to pursue.

Research Areas

  • Health sciences
  • Healthcare
  • Doctoral research

Funding and Duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionPhD scholarship / studentship
Stipend / salaryGBP 21,805/year (2026/27 rate)

Eligibility and Requirements

These scholarships are open to UK applicants only. An MSc in a relevant subject area is ideal, and applicants holding a first-class honours degree may also be considered.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusOpen
Deadline / consideration round30 October 2026; references 6 November
LocationUnited Kingdom

About University of Huddersfield

The University of Huddersfield offers research degrees through its academic schools. Its human and health sciences scholarship opportunities support research linked to healthcare, health science and related practice.

Official details: Read the programme or project information

Application route: Follow the official application instructions

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Official Link

Full announcement and application portal: https://www.hud.ac.uk/postgraduate/research/research-scholarships/health-science-and-healthcare/

Source: hud.ac.uk - the details in this listing were recorded from this official page.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 30 October 2026; references 6 November - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 30 October 2026; references 6 November. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.

Open the official application page ↗

Application guides

  • How to Read a PhD Job Advert: Funding, Eligibility and Application Steps
  • Academic CV for PhD Applications: Structure and an Example
  • UK Student Visa Application: CAS, Documents and Financial Evidence

English language requirements

Huddersfield asks research applicants for IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with no element below 6.0, and the online edition of the test is not accepted. Its 2026/27 funded places are also closed to international applicants, so this route mainly suits UK-home applicants who do not need a test.
